t: Titan 18V 5.0Ah Li-Ion TXP battery and charger kit provides reliable power for a range of cordless tools. Designed for trade professionals, it ensures consistent performance on demanding job sites, from carpentry to plumbing. A robust 5.0Ah capacity battery offers extended run-time, reducing interruptions during tasks. The battery can be recharged in just 75 minutes using the fast charger supplied, minimising downtime. Compatibility with any Titan 18V TXP tool makes it a versatile addition to an existing kit. The low battery indicator helps manage power effectively.
